name: Albert Einstein
subject: physics
description: Formulated the theory of relativity, revolutionizing our understanding of space, time, and gravity.

name: Sir Isaac Newton
subject: physics
description: Formulated the laws of motion and universal gravitation that dominated scientists' view of the physical universe.

name: Nikola Tesla
subject: physics
description: Designed the modern alternating current (AC) electricity supply system.

name: Max Planck
subject: physics
description: Originated quantum theory, which won him the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1918.

name: Michael Faraday
subject: physics
description: Discovered electromagnetic induction, laying the foundation for electric motors and generators.

name: Niels Bohr
subject: physics
description: Proposed the quantized model of the atom, explaining how electrons occupy fixed energy levels.

name: Werner Heisenberg
subject: physics
description: Formulated the uncertainty principle, a cornerstone of quantum mechanics.

name: Richard Feynman
subject: physics
description: Simplified particle interactions with intuitive diagrams and helped build the theory of quantum electrodynamics.

name: Galileo Galilei
subject: physics
description: Championed heliocentrism and derived the laws governing falling bodies and pendulums.

name: Sir C. V. Raman
subject: physics
description: Discovered the Raman effect, showing how light changes wavelength when it scatters through a molecule.

name: Satyendra Nath Bose
subject: physics
description: Developed the statistics that describe how identical particles called bosons behave, the basis of Bose–Einstein statistics.

name: Ernest Rutherford
subject: physics
description: Discovered the atomic nucleus with his gold foil experiment, reshaping atomic theory.

name: James Clerk Maxwell
subject: physics
description: Unified electricity, magnetism, and light into a single theory of electromagnetism.

name: Marie Curie
subject: chemistry
description: Conducted pioneering research on radioactivity and discovered the elements polonium and radium.

name: Dmitri Mendeleev
subject: chemistry
description: Created the periodic table, organizing every known element by atomic weight and recurring properties.

name: Antoine Lavoisier
subject: chemistry
description: Established the law of conservation of mass, laying the foundation of modern chemistry.

name: John Dalton
subject: chemistry
description: Proposed that matter is made of indivisible atoms, founding modern atomic theory.

name: Linus Pauling
subject: chemistry
description: Advanced the theory of chemical bonding and introduced the modern concept of electronegativity.

name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
subject: math
description: Made substantial contributions to mathematical analysis, number theory, and infinite series.

name: Carl Friedrich Gauss
subject: math
description: Contributed foundational work across number theory, statistics, and geometry, earning the title "Prince of Mathematicians."

name: Leonhard Euler
subject: math
description: Introduced much of modern mathematical notation and worked across nearly every branch of mathematics.

name: Pythagoras
subject: math
description: Established the relationship between the sides of a right triangle, foundational to geometry.

name: Aryabhata
subject: math
description: Pioneered early place-value notation, approximated π, and modeled planetary motion in ancient India.

name: Ada Lovelace
subject: math
description: Wrote the first algorithm intended for a mechanical computer, envisioning computing beyond pure calculation.
